appearance: Dry night race, with blue-hour race start.

origin.meaning: Local source origin at the point on the loop nearest the venue coordinate, after rotation to the start.

native_station_frame.side_convention: Driver left/right in forward lap direction; geographic footprints retain source east/north coordinates.

review.method: Viewed every frame of overview and detail contact sheets. Sparse review of edited gameplay; rear cameras, menus and cuts are excluded as metric geometry evidence.

sectors.name: Pit straight, T1–3
sectors.observed: Long white layered pit building on right, opposite roof stand; close sponsor walls and tall catchfence. Large green/blue painted escape at first left/right. Palms and low white utility buildings beyond wall.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Southern fast esses
sectors.observed: Narrow asphalt channel between concrete and continuous mesh; red-white narrow apex kerbs, occasional green-painted outer lane. Blue evening sky over white apartment and event blocks, not continuous generic forest.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Fast coastal sequence toward northern hairpin
sectors.observed: Fast coastal sequence behind close fencing and residential balconies. The Diamond Tower site is visible ahead/right as an exposed concrete construction core with crane in323s; no finished glazed skyscraper facade should be inferred from the planned OSM height.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Northern T13 banked hairpin
sectors.observed: Broad round hairpin with green painted outside apron and red-white inside kerb. Pale coastal buildings and hospitality above fence; low palms on planted islands. Preserve curved protection and clear paved escape geometry.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Return technical sweepers
sectors.observed: Fast close-wall bends, palm clumps and flat white/cream buildings behind mesh. Paint stays alongside kerb instead of blanket gravel; visible repeated lamp poles with paired arms.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T17–21 direction changes
sectors.observed: Interlinked narrow wall corridors; large blue-green paved escape only where justified, red-white kerbs at individual apexes. Low service compounds and palms; night lighting must show asphalt and wall base.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Long southern acceleration and T22–26
sectors.observed: Long flowing fenced run, articulated pit/hospitality visible across road loop. Sponsor bridges and uninterrupted light rows; small green verge beside wall; no grass parkland replacing paved shoulders.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T27 hairpin and return pit straight
sectors.observed: Wide slow left turnaround, coloured paved runoff and terminal impact barriers, mainstand and high white-framed pit decks dominate. Preserve hotel/site access behind fence, continuous curved outer protection.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

uncertainties: GLO-90 is not racing-deck height on the close coastal roads. Preserve flat visual horizon rather than propagating roofs into road.
Barrier-vertex median widths cannot reproduce chicane escape lanes; author terminal protection behind paved escape, never directly across turn exit.

targeted_registration_review.method: Direct appearance/topology checks of retained frames and bounded individual Baku reference seeks; source geometry and all native data unchanged.
targeted_registration_review.notes: Targeted frame review corrects331.06s to northern T13banked hairpin (~40s relative lap timer), not the southern esses.291s is late T27(~1:21), followed by pit return;307–327s begins a later-lap opening/esses sequence. Exact native station association remains a visual estimate, approximately±60m. Sponsor colours alone do not establish corner identity; older overview links elsewhere remain contextual until full-lap continuity review.
targeted_registration_review.next_gate: Actual packaged full-lap review and targeted captures in build/reviews/east-final-targets.json; these metadata corrections are not visual approval.

diamond_tower_reference.observed: Distant skeletal silhouette and close exposed concrete/core with crane. The close top is cropped; the wider image constrains the broad mass, not a precise measured height.
diamond_tower_reference.base_evidence: Adjacent native road3.24m; source-footprint corners2.41–3.24m, center3.13m. Site-level road datum chosen, avoiding any addition of height on a DSM roof.
diamond_tower_reference.state_correction: Fully glazed planned-height placeholder replaced by open concrete floorplates/columns, exposed core, top formwork and tower crane. Existing footprint and world registration retained.
diamond_tower_reference.runtime_gate: Requires actual packaged capture and Luna High comparison; source check is not appearance approval.

coastal_water_correction.omission_fixed: The previous venue contained no sea geometry and rendered the coastal scenery grid as Runoff. Actual directed shoreline faces now replace only mapped water, retaining land, buildings and pier footprints.
coastal_water_correction.preservation: Water is appended only to water_shapes, never extra_corridors. Native roads/protection and mapped building/pier land are excluded. Actual coast edges and island holes are retained. Terrain under water is removed; flat water uses the existing Water material. Native road XYZ, widths, bank and physics are untouched.
coastal_water_correction.pier_levels: Actual mapped footprints. Each deck is estimated from retained ground at the closest coastline vertex, with minimum 0.6 m freeboard. These are original scenery reconstructions, not surveyed pier elevations.

source_checks.coastal_roof_overhang: Only 28 high parapet triangles on mapped coastal building1258945369 project beyond the footprint: 0.8 m beams centered on roof edges create about 0.4 m overhang. All overlap is at z9.399–9.899 m, not foundations or submerged offices. No other structural overlap was found.

coastal_water_correction.reference_visibility: Supplied cockpit sequences reviewed here mostly hide coastal water behind barriers, buildings and trees. They establish context and day/night appearance, not a surveyed sea-camera pair. Direct geographic water context comes from the official aerial/map listed below. Off-axis absence from a cockpit still is not evidence that water is missing.
coastal_water_correction.next_gate: Fresh source generation/import and complete packaged live lap with Luna High. Source topology and height proofs are not rendered acceptance.

vertical_registration.source_note: OpenRedSea zeroMSL minus retained native scenery datum. Lagoon shown by officialF1 circuit overview/OSMrelation; shared flat level estimated, not tide/hydraulic survey.

primary_visual_context.supports: Viewed official 2021 planned aerial: sea and enclosed lagoon on opposite sides of the race peninsula, preserving islands/piers. This is geography context, not evidence for current building completion or a direct cockpit pose.

supplied_context_frames.observed: Actual night road/building/lighting context; water occluded, not a direct water view.
